g.text: Gas transfer across an observed barrier
Proposed animation keyframes: fixed rat TEM underneath, symbolic NET transfer above it.
Example fixed pressures: O₂ air 100 / blood 40 mmHg; CO₂ air 40 / blood 46 mmHg.
O₂ in alveolar air; CO₂ in blood space.
Opposite net directions across intact tissue.
O₂ reaches blood; CO₂ reaches air.
Packets and routes are symbols, not measured molecules, sizes, counts or trajectories. No biological clock.
Planned controls: play/pause, seek/step, speed, and per-gas equal/reversed pressure presets. Equal pressure means zero NET transfer.
Rat perfusion-fixed TEM, Knudsen et al. (2023), Figure 1A · CC BY 4.0 · display crop; original labels and 0.5 μm bar retained.
